nodes.description: Ownable._owner: current owner address, guards onlyOwner functions
Ownable._previousOwner: stashed owner used by lock/unlock
Ownable._lockTime: timestamp until which ownership is locked
_takeOwned mapping: token balances of excluded accounts
_isBot mapping blocking blacklisted addresses from transfers
_reflectTotal: total reflection supply derived from MAX
_taxFeeFlag: master switch deciding if fees are taken
uniswapRouter: IUniswapV2Router02 used for swaps and liquidity
isIntoLiquifySwap: reentrancy guard flag for swapAndLiquify
ethTCGCoin20 constructor: mints reflections to deployer and configures router/pair
_setRouterAddressByOwner: onlyOwner wrapper to reconfigure router and factory
balanceOf: returns take balance for excluded accounts else reflection-derived balance
transfer: external ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer
transferFrom: spends allowance and delegates to _transfer
setNumTokensSellToAddToLiquidity: onlyOwner setter for the swap threshold
_getValues: bundles T and R value computations
_getTValues: computes take amount, tax and liquidity portions
_getRValues: converts T values to reflection values using currentRate
_getRate: rSupply / tSupply division used by reflection math
rescueTokensFromContract: onlyOwner ETH or token rescue from contract
removeAllFee: zeroes fees storing previous values
restoreAllFee: restores previously stored fee values
excludeFromFee: onlyOwner adds address to fee exclusion
includeInFee: onlyOwner removes address from fee exclusion
setDexWithSellFee: onlyOwner flags address for sell fee
setDexWithBuyFee: onlyOwner flags address for buy fee
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled: onlyOwner toggle of auto liquidity
receive: payable fallback accepting ETH from router swaps
_takeLiquidity: mints reflection liquidity into the contract address
swapAndLiquifyByOwner: onlyOwner manual trigger of swapAndLiquify
swapAndLiquify: splits balance, swaps half to ETH and adds liquidity under lockSwaping
swapTokensForETH: approves router and swaps tokens for ETH
addLiquidity: approves router and calls addLiquidityETH paying ETH
tokenFromReflection: converts reflection amount to take amount
_transfer: core transfer with bot checks, max tx cap, auto-liquify and fee selection
_tokenTransfer: applies fee removal, computes values and mutates reflection balances
unlock: restores _previousOwner if caller matches and lock expired (timestamp gated)
lock: onlyOwner sets _lockTime = block.timestamp + time and zeroes owner
renounceOwnership: onlyOwner sets owner to zero
Address._functionCallWithValue: low-level call with value and revert bubbling
Address.sendValue: balance check then low-level value call
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for auth and transfers
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for locks and swap deadlines
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) ETH payout in rescueTokensFromContract / sendValue call
uniswapRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call (accepts any ETH, deadline = block.timestamp)
uniswapRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount} external call with zero slippage protection
rSupply.div(tSupply) in _getRate: division by zero reverts, rate can be manipulated
_reflectOwned[sender].sub(reflectAmount) in _tokenTransfer can underflow-revert on inconsistent state
initialBalance local capturing ETH before swap
newBalance local measuring ETH gained from swap
takeFee local in _transfer (assigned, never compared, due to 'if(takeFee = true)')

edges.reason: constructor stores the uniswap router instance
constructor creates and stores the uniswap pair
constructor excludes owner and contract from fees
constructor assigns full reflection supply to deployer
msg.sender is checked by onlyOwner before privileged setter executes
msg.sender is checked by onlyOwner before fund rescue executes
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender granting ownership control
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address
setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee with an owner-supplied value
setMaxTxPercent reads _takeTotal for the max tx computation
setupBot writes _isBot allowing owner to blacklist any address
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify (external router calls) before recipient balances are updated
_transfer reads _isDEXSellFee[to] to enable the sell fee
_transfer reads _isDEXBuyFee[from] to enable the buy fee
_transfer mutates _liquidityFee via assignment instead of comparison (if(takeFee = true))
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the auto-liquify
_transfer assigns takeFee = true inside an if condition instead of comparing
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false
_tokenTransfer state can desync _takeOwned for excluded accounts
_tokenTransfer performs reflection balance subtraction that can revert on underflow
_getTValues subtracts tax and liquidity from the transfer amount
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply with no zero check
_getRate stores the division result in the currentRate local
rescueTokensFromContract performs a native ETH transfer to the owner
rescueTokensFromContract calls _tokenTransfer to move tokens out
swapAndLiquify swaps half the tokens for ETH
swapAndLiquify adds the other half plus ETH as liquidity
swapAndLiquify measures ETH gained from the swap
swapTokensForETH performs the external router swap
swapTokensForETH uses block.timestamp as the swap deadline
router swap sends ETH back into the receive() fallback during _transfer execution
addLiquidity makes an external addLiquidityETH call with value which can invoke receive()
addLiquidity sends LP tokens to owner()
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline
unlock requires _previousOwner to match the caller
unlock is gated purely on block.timestamp (miner manipulable)
lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner
transferOwnership writes _owner with an owner-supplied address
sendValue performs a low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient
_setRouterAddress excludes the factory address from fees
